_comment: Fragment 59 — D-104: the channel's own documentation was the one file nothing read; Phase gets its definition; Lane A reselected Active. Merged 2026-08-24.

nodes.label: D-104 — The Channel's Own Documentation Was the One File Nothing Read
nodes.description: The handoff directory's readme and template were invisible to every control: the receipt check filters entry filenames, the manifest asserts only that they exist, and graph coverage only that they appear in the graph.
nodes.rationale: The readme drifted through three decisions with every check green, ending up without the resolution state most entries carried, with two restated counts, and with no mention of the carve-out that makes the channel usable during a handover.

nodes.label: A Control Scoped to Entries, Blind to the File Governing Entries
nodes.description: The earlier recorded gap was a control scoped to one lane and blind to the other. This is the same shape one level up: scoped to the artifacts, blind to their instructions.
nodes.rationale: Filename filters are the recurring mechanism. A filter narrow enough to define the check's subject is also narrow enough to exclude the thing that defines the subject.

nodes.label: Check 16 — Vocabulary and Fields Coupled Both Ways
nodes.description: Every resolution the closure check implements must be named in both documents and every resolution offered must be implemented; every declared field must be read by some check and every field read must be declared; and neither document may carry a restated count.
nodes.rationale: Everything it compares is derived from source rather than restated, which is what separates it from the tallies it forbids. A one-way check licenses the other direction, which is why both are enforced.

nodes.label: A Check That Reads Its Own Documentation as Source Is Measuring Itself
nodes.description: On its first run the check scanned its own file and reported a doc comment naming an accessor call as a field the template had failed to declare.
nodes.rationale: It also caught a restated count written minutes earlier by the pass repairing the readme, and a dead resolution word that had been introduced and superseded in the same earlier decision without ever reaching either document.

nodes.label: Phase Names Who Owns the Correction, Because Blocks Already Names the Consequence
nodes.description: The field was made mandatory without a definition, leaving three readings live: the phase you work in, the phase you are blocked on, and the phase that must fix it.
nodes.rationale: A phase meaning what this blocks would be a second copy of the blocking field, and a duplicated fact is the drift mechanism recorded repeatedly here. It is also the only reading that makes the closure condition mean anything, since that condition is about defects in a phase's own artifacts.

nodes.label: A Review Finding Withdrawn Before It Was Acted On
nodes.description: The directory review reported two entries as mislabelled. It had assumed one of the three live readings without deciding it, and acting on the finding would have re-filed two correct entries into the wrong phase.
nodes.rationale: The ambiguity the finding rested on was real and is what the definition fixes. The mislabelling it inferred from that ambiguity was not, and withdrawing it before acting is cheaper than propagating it.

nodes.label: An Answer Written in the Present Tense Goes False Silently
nodes.description: One answer asserted that another entry was verified. A later decision moved that entry to the provisional state and the sentence stayed on the page, correct about the moment it was written and wrong about the present.
nodes.rationale: An answer is an append-only record of what was said then, so the correction is appended rather than edited in. Every answer in the directory carries the same exposure, and dating the claim or naming the decision is what limits it.

nodes.label: A Handover That Costs Nothing Stops Meaning Anything
nodes.description: Two Sprint boundaries were declared in one day and the first produced no commits, so the mechanism is being used to switch who may edit rather than to mark a cycle.
nodes.rationale: No minimum is imposed, because a check enforcing a cycle length would fire on the legitimate short cycle, which is the property that makes a control get ignored. It is watched rather than gated.
